texts.zh:
在碎片的另一头，我们发现了一座与我们自己恒星基地相似的结构。我们的裂隙探球刚一接近，就收到了许多语言和许多频段的问候。令人惊讶的是，这是我们自己的语言。

招待我们人与我们一样惊讶，因为我们居然也在说着他们的语言。但在简短礼貌的交谈后，我们发现这块星域是一个与我们颇为相似的宇航文明。他们自称为[mirrored_empire.GetName]。他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们已经抛弃了迷信，但他们仍保有天真的信仰体系。

这些人们混杂着熟悉感和陌生感，令人有些不安。我们也许可以与他们合作，但我们能相信这些镜像人吗？
texts.en:
Beyond the rift, we discovered a structure that resembled one of our own starbases. As soon as our Rift Sphere approached, we were hailed in a number of languages and on several frequencies. Surprisingly, one of those languages was our own.

Our hosts were just as shocked as we were to encounter aliens speaking their own tongue. But after a brief exchange of courtesies, we learned that this sector is home to a space-faring civilization much like our own. They call it the [mirrored_empire.GetName]. They share many of our ideals, but where we have cast off superstition, they still cling to their naive belief systems.

These people are a disturbing mix of the familiar and the strange. It might be possible to work with them, but can we trust these doppelgangers?

texts.zh:
我们的裂隙探球刚一抵达恒星基地，就收到了许多语言在不同频段上的问候。

这座空间站的拥有者只在一瞬间就翻译了我们的语言，并且邀请我们登站互通有无。

我们这才发现这片星域是一个主要由[mirrored_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构成的文明的家园，他们自称为[mirrored_empire.GetName]。
texts.en:
As soon as our Rift Sphere arrived at the starbase, we were hailed in a number of languages and on several frequencies.

The owners of the station successfully translated our language with remarkable speed and welcomed us aboard to exchange information.

We have since discovered that this sector is home to a civilization primarily composed of [mirrored_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that calls itself the [mirrored_empire.GetName].

texts.zh:
过去几个月，我们都在与[mirrored_empire.GetName]进行文化交换。
他们的历史与我们在超光速科技发现为止如出一辙，但他们后来遭遇了一艘无比强大的未知外星舰船。这艘舰船目中无人地继续航行，没人知道它的目的，但这次遭遇深深撼动了他们的社会的根基。看到他们在对抗这艘舰船时如此无助，给他们的意识形态带去了翻天覆地的变化，倒向了唯心主义。

对我们而言，他们显然做出了错误的选择，但这也给我们提出了一个有趣的问题。如果我们的社会也在那么早期遭遇到相同的事情，我们也会走上那样错误的道路吗？

他们很不幸运地在影响重大的前超光速阶段遭遇这样的事。他们基础思潮的改变大大拖慢了帝国的发展。
texts.en:
We have spent the last month in a cultural exchange with the [mirrored_empire.GetName].
Their society mirrored our own until briefly before FTL technology was discovered, when they encountered an unknown alien vessel of unimaginable power. The vessel moved on without its purpose ever being discovered, but the brief visit shocked their society to the core. Seeing how helpless they would have been against this craft lead to an upheaval in their ideology and a shift towards spiritualism.

It is clear to us that they made the incorrect choice, but it does pose an interesting question. Would our society also have gone down the wrong path had the same thing happened to us so early on?

It is unfortunate for them that this event happened during the impressionable pre-FTL period of their history. Changing their foundational ethics undoubtedly slowed the progress of their empire.

对我们而言，他们显然做出了错误的选择，但这也给我们提出了一个有趣的问题。如果我们的社会也在那么早期遭遇到相同的事情，我们也会走上那样错误的道路吗？

他们很不幸运地在影响重大的前超光速阶段遭遇这样的事。他们基础思潮的改变大大拖慢了帝国的发展。
texts.en:
We have spent the last month in a cultural exchange with the [mirrored_empire.GetName].
Their society mirrored our own until briefly before FTL technology was discovered, when they encountered an unknown alien vessel of unimaginable power. The vessel moved on without its purpose ever being discovered, but the brief visit shocked their society to the core. Seeing how helpless they would have been against these technologically advanced visitors lead to an upheaval in their ideology and a shift towards egalitarianism.

It is clear to us that they made the incorrect choice, but it does pose an interesting question. Would our society also have gone down the wrong path had the same thing happened to us so early on?

It is unfortunate for them that this event happened during the impressionable pre-FTL period of their history. Changing their foundational ethics undoubtedly slowed the progress of their empire.

texts.zh:
尽管我们有许多相似点，但我们很难相信这些接纳了唯心主义的人。在表面上我们与[mirrored_empire.GetName]进行着信息文化的交换，背地里悄悄地调查他们的军事能力。

[mirrored_empire.GetName]的计算机使用与我们相似的加密系统，进入他们的数据库易如反掌。

这个文明的军事科技与我们大致相同，但也存在足够大的差异，让他们的舰船图解对工程师们而言已经足够有趣了。
texts.en:
Despite our many similarities, it is hard to trust people who embrace spiritualism. While on the surface we engaged in a cultural exchange of information with the [mirrored_empire.GetName], behind the scenes we quietly investigated their military capabilities.

[mirrored_empire.GetName]'s computers use a similar encryption to our own, which made accessing their databases extremely easy.

This civilization's military technology is similar to our own, but there are enough differences that the schemata of their vessels should prove interesting to our engineers.

texts.zh:
我们花费了过去的一周与[mirrored_empire.GetName]进行了文化交换。

我们的兴趣很快变成了警觉，因为发现这些生物是破坏集体意识的残余物。在他们文明发展的某个时间点上，他们的意识被个体概念荼毒了。他们有目的地割裂自身，慢慢地每个自个体都不再听从集体，只忠于自己了。
texts.en:
We have spent the last week in a cultural exchange with the [mirrored_empire.GetName].

Our interest quickly turned to alarm as we discovered that these beings are what remains of a broken collective consciousness. At some point in their civilization's development, their mind became poisoned with the concept of individuality. Purposefully segmenting itself over time, eventually each drone began to hear no thoughts but their own.

texts.zh:
似乎我们在空间站的存在激起了他们指挥链的警觉。一位[mirrored_empire.GetName]特使被派到恒星基地以讨论我们人民的未来。

他们热情洋溢地阐述了我们的相似之处远大于不同之处，并辩称两边人民的协调一致对双方都好。

我们确实承袭了很多共同点。我们要怎么回应呢？
texts.en:
It seems knowledge of our presence on the station has escalated up their chain of command. An emissary of the [mirrored_empire.GetName] has been assigned to the starbase to discuss the future of our peoples.

They have made an impassioned case that our similarities far outweigh our differences. They argue that an arrangement between our people would benefit both sides.

It is true that we share a unique heritage together. How do we wish to respond?

texts.zh:
似乎我们在空间站的存在激起了他们指挥链的警觉。一位[mirrored_empire.GetName]特使被派到恒星基地以讨论我们人民的未来。

他们不但排斥我们，而且不理解我们。他们辩称两边人民的协调一致对双方都好。

我们要怎么回应呢？
texts.en:
It seems knowledge of our presence on the station has escalated up their chain of command. An emissary of the [mirrored_empire.GetName] has been assigned to the starbase to discuss the future of our peoples.

While they do not like us, they do understand us. They argue that an arrangement between our people would benefit both sides.

How do we wish to respond?

texts.zh:
似乎我们在空间站的存在激起了他们指挥链的警觉。一位[mirrored_empire.GetName]特使被派到恒星基地以讨论我们人民的未来。

他们热情洋溢地阐述了我们除了名字不同以外就是一样的人。在一个充满了未知力量的星系中，我们之间的友谊毫无疑问会为双方都带去好处的。

我们要怎么回应呢？
texts.en:
It seems knowledge of our presence on the station has escalated up their chain of command. An emissary of the [mirrored_empire.GetName] has been assigned to the starbase to discuss the future of our peoples.

They have made an impassioned case that we are one people in all but name. Surely in a galaxy full of unknown powers, a friendship between us would serve to benefit both parties.

How do we wish to respond?

label.zh: 欢迎双方帝国间的友谊。

label.en: This is of no interest to us.

texts.zh:
似乎我们在空间站的存在激起了他们指挥链的警觉。一位[mirrored_empire.GetName]特使被派到恒星基地以讨论我们人民的未来。

他们热情洋溢地阐述了我们的相似之处远大于不同之处，并辩称两边人民的协调一致对双方都好。

这场闹剧已经进行得够久了。从他们那里我们已经拿走了能拿的一切，对跨次元的进一步外交也兴趣平平。
texts.en:
It seems knowledge of our presence on the station has escalated up their chain of command. An emissary of the [mirrored_empire.GetName] has been assigned to the starbase to discuss the future of our peoples.

They have made an impassioned case that our similarities far outweigh our differences. They argue that an arrangement between our people would benefit both sides.

This farce has proceeded long enough. We have taken what we can from them and hold no interest in further diplomacy across the dimensions.

似乎我们在空间站的存在激起了他们指挥链的警觉。一位[mirrored_empire.GetName]特使被派到恒星基地以讨论我们人民的未来。

This farce has proceeded long enough. We have taken what we can from them and hold no interest in further diplomacy across the dimensions.

texts.zh:
我们给予大使积极正面的回应。

促进两个宇宙间的长期沟通渠道正在建立起来。他们分散的思维虽然效率不及我们，但可以在我们与其他的分散个体群之间充当“润滑剂”的功能。
texts.en:
We have given the emissary a favorable response.

Work is being done to facilitate a more permanent pathway between our two universes. Their disconnected minds, while inferior in their efficiency, will serve fittingly as liaisons between ourselves and other hordes of individuals.

texts.zh:
我们给予大使积极正面的回应。

促进两个宇宙间的长期沟通渠道正在建立起来。尽管还没有确定任何事情，大使指出，[final_mirrored_empire.GetName]会对贸易协定更感兴趣。
texts.en:
We have given the emissary a favorable response.

Work is being done to facilitate a more permanent pathway between our two universes. Although nothing is decided yet, the emissary has indicated that [final_mirrored_empire.GetName] would be interested in trade agreements.

texts.zh:
我们给予大使积极正面的回应。

促进两个宇宙间的长期沟通渠道正在建立起来。尽管还没有确定任何事情，大使指出，[final_mirrored_empire.GetName]会对贸易协定更感兴趣。

我们很期待与我们能视为表亲的人们通力协作。
texts.en:
We have given the emissary a favorable response.

Work is being done to facilitate a more permanent pathway between our two universes. Although nothing is decided yet, the emissary has indicated that [final_mirrored_empire.GetName] would be interested in trade agreements.

We look forward to working with a people that we consider to be our close cousins.

texts.zh:
我们给予大使负面的回应。

尽管[final_mirrored_empire.GetName]对所谓的相似点和共同未来夸夸其谈，但是对能为我们人民带来繁荣的基本理念嗤之以鼻。

撂下我们的话之后，在他们对我们的外交豁免权达到极限之前，我们迅速回到了裂隙探球上。

尽管我们无意与这群人保持联络，但研究两个社会间的差异让我们对自己的理解又更加深入了。
texts.en:
We have given the emissary a negative response.

For all their talk of similarities and a shared future, [final_mirrored_empire.GetName] turned their back on the fundamental ideals that make our people great.

Having said our piece, we swiftly returned to our Rift Sphere before they decided that our diplomatic immunity had reached its limits.

Although we have no plans to maintain contact with these people, studying the differences between this civilization and our own has taught us a great deal about ourselves.

texts.zh:
我们给予大使负面的回应。

尽管他们对所谓相似之处夸夸其谈，但我们觉得没有什么事比抛弃集体更加可恶了。

在阐明了我们的立场之后，[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]迅速地返回了裂隙探球以免事态发生什么意料之外的变化。

他们应该为自己的距离遥远感到幸运。
texts.en:
We have given the emissary a negative response.

For all their talk of similarities, we can think of nothing more abhorrent than abandoning the collective.

Having made our stance clear, our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural] swiftly returned to the Rift Sphere before the situation took a more dangerous turn.

They are lucky their civilization is so far out of reach.
